Shark FlexStyle® 1.25" Auto-Wrap Curlers
The Shark FlexStyle® Styling Auto-Wrap Curler attaches to the Shark FlexStyle® and automatically wraps, curls, and sets your hair with Coanda technology. The airflow gently pulls in hair to wrap for hassle-free curls in seconds.
Shark FlexStyle® 0.95" Auto-Wrap Curlers
The Shark FlexStyle® Styling Auto-Wrap Curler attaches to the Shark FlexStyle® and automatically wraps, curls, and sets your hair with Coanda technology. The airflow gently pulls in hair to wrap for hassle-free curls in seconds.
Shark FlexStyle® Oval Brush
The Shark FlexStyle® Oval Brush dries as it styles with powerful airflow, bringing your hair's shine to a new level. Smoothing boar and nylon bristles grab, smooth, and defrizz, while delivering volume and bounce.
Shark FlexStyle® Paddle Brush
The Shark FlexStyle® Paddle Brush attaches to the Shark FlexStyle® and employs powerful airflow to straighten and smooth your hair faster. Smoothing boar and nylon bristles enable grabbing, smoothing, and shining, while combing and detangling.
Shark FlexStyle® Round Brush
The Shark FlexStyle® Round Brush dries as it styles with powerful airflow, bringing your hair’s shine & volume to a new level. Smoothing boar & nylon bristles grab, smooth & defrizz, while delivering bounce.
Shark FlexStyle® Styling Concentrator
The Shark FlexStyle® Styling Concentrator attaches to the Shark FlexStyle® hair dryer to straighten & smooth hair, giving you a sleek, smooth finish every time. With a rotatable nozzle for easy styling, you can effortlessly perfect your blowout.
Shark FlexStyle® FrizzFighter™ Finishing Tool
The Shark FlexStyle® FrizzFighter™ Finishing Tool automatically attracts hair, fights frizz, and smooths flyaways. It uses Coanda airflow technology with two streams of air to collect and smooth flyways on dry, straight or straightened hair.
Shark FlexStyle® Curl-Defining Diffuser
The Shark FlexStyle® Curl-Defining Diffuser attaches to the Shark FlexStyle® for fast, even drying from root to tip. To enable curl-perfection, our diffuser features retractable and extendable prongs. Retract prongs for shorter, finer hair and less heat on the scalp. Extend prongs for longer, thicker hair and for reaching and lifting at the root.
Shark FlexStyle® Wide-Tooth Comb
The Shark FlexStyle® Wide-Tooth Comb, best for coily & curly hair types, uses two rows & two lengths of teeth to expertly stretch & lengthen natural curls from root to tip, with no heat damage. Compatible with Shark FlexStyle®.

With the Shark FlexStyle® Air Styling & Drying System, you can easily transform between a powerful, fast, hair dryer, and an ultra-versatile multi-styler with no-heat-damage. One twist is all it takes to flex from one to the other. Attach different stylers and unlock the ability to curl, volumize, smooth, and dry. Lightweight & powerful, FlexStyle® is the answer to fast, easy styling.

  • MULTI-STYLING TOOL: Rotate the hair dryer into a versatile multi-styler.
  • CURL, VOLUMIZE, SMOOTH, & DRY: Attach versatile stylers for any hair type.
  • NO HEAT DAMAGE: Healthy hair starts with no heat damage. Shark® FlexStyle® measures & regulates temperatures 1000x per second, minimizing heat exposure.
  • POWERFUL, FAST DRYING: Compact and lightweight without compromise on power.
  • FOR ALL HAIRKIND™: A multi-styler for straight, wavy, curly, and coily hair.
  • BUILD YOUR OWN: Choose any 3 stylers best for your hair type and styling needs.
